visual_elements.description: Large white rectangle with a thin (~2px) solid blue border, no fill pattern, no shadow; contains the 4 agenda bullets with generous internal padding on left and top.
Thin dark-red horizontal rule across the top of the slide and a matching thin dark-red vertical rule down the left edge, forming an open frame corner.
Solid black rectangular bar spanning the full slide width at the very bottom, empty of text.
Small white/black mouse-pointer arrow (screen-recording cursor artifact) resting on the tail of the word 'Convolutional' in the fourth bullet; not part of the intended design.

imagery: No photos, icons, or illustrations; only the incidental mouse-cursor arrow artifact near 'Convolutional'.
typography_notes: Title is a bold serif (Times New Roman-like), roughly 40pt, red, title-case, centered. Body bullets are a bold sans-serif (Verdana/Arial-like), roughly 24-26pt, royal blue, sentence case, each preceded by a small solid round bullet in black/dark color. No italics, no all-caps, no numbering. Strong contrast between serif title and sans-serif body.
animation_state: No mid-build state: all 4 bullets are fully revealed. The only overlay is a mouse cursor on bullet 4, indicating a recorded pointer rather than an animation.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E9E9E9). 2. Draw a thin (~1.5pt) dark-red (#B22222) horizontal line across the top at ~7% height, from ~5% to ~95% width; draw a matching vertical line down the left edge at ~5% width from ~7% to ~95% height. 3. Add a centered text box near the top (~12%-22% vertical) with the text 'Agenda' in bold serif (Times New Roman), ~40pt, color #B22222. 4. Insert a white-filled rectangle with a ~2pt solid blue (#1A1ACC) border, positioned ~11%-89% horizontal and ~26%-85% vertical, no shadow. 5. Inside the rectangle, add a bulleted list, left-aligned with ~5% left padding, font bold sans-serif (Verdana or Arial), ~24-26pt, color #1A1ACC, round black bullet markers, with these four lines in order: 'Quick revision of Machine Learning', 'Deep Learning vs Machine Learning', 'Quick revision of Neural Network', 'Introduction to Convolutional Neural Network'. Space lines evenly (~13% vertical spacing). 6. Do NOT add the mouse-cursor artifact (it is a recording artifact, not slide content). 7. Add a solid black (#000000) rectangle across the full width at the bottom (~6% of slide height) as a footer bar with no text. 8. Verify no slide number, logo, or footer text is present.
